name: ChartBrowser
summary: ChartBrowser is a utility EA that lists all open charts, indicators, experts, and scripts in sorted order and provides fast switching between them via a custom dialog interface. It does not open any trades or execute any trading strategy, functioning purely as a chart navigation and management tool.
summary_zh: ChartBrowser是一个工具型EA，用于列出所有打开的图表、指标、EA和脚本，并按排序顺序显示。它提供快速切换功能，通过自定义对话框界面在图表之间导航，不执行任何交易操作。
strategy_analysis: 该EA不是交易策略EA，而是一个图表浏览和导航工具。它基于MetaQuotes的标准Controls库构建了一个自定义对话框界面，包含CWnd、CRect等基础UI组件。核心功能是枚举当前终端中所有打开的图表及其附加的指标、EA和脚本，并以排序方式展示给用户。用户可以通过对话框快速切换到不同的图表窗口。该工具不涉及任何入场条件、出场条件、仓位管理或资金管理的逻辑。它的价值在于提升多图表操作时的工作效率，特别是在同时监控多个交易品种的场景下。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a chart browsing and navigation utility. It builds a custom dialog interface based on MetaQuotes' standard Controls library, including foundational UI components like CWnd, CRect, and other window management classes. The core functionality enumerates all open charts in the terminal along with their attached indicators, EAs, and scripts, then displays them in sorted order. Users can quickly switch between different chart windows through the dialog. It does not involve any entry conditions, exit conditions, position sizing, or money management logic. Its value lies in improving workflow efficiency when operating multiple charts, especially in scenarios where multiple trading instruments are being monitored simultaneously.
pros: 提供高效的图表切换功能，适合同时监控多个交易品种的交易者
基于标准Controls库构建，UI组件经过MetaQuotes官方验证，稳定性较好
列出图表上附加的所有指标、EA和脚本，提供完整的图表信息概览
排序显示功能使查找特定图表更加便捷
开源代码结构清晰，便于学习和自定义扩展
pros_en: Provides efficient chart switching functionality, ideal for traders monitoring multiple instruments simultaneously
Built on the standard Controls library with MetaQuotes-verified UI components, ensuring good stability
Lists all indicators, EAs, and scripts attached to each chart, providing a complete overview of chart information
Sorted display makes it convenient to find specific charts quickly
Open-source code with clear structure, easy to learn from and customize for extensions
cons: 纯工具性质，不具备任何交易功能，对于只需交易自动化的用户无直接价值
依赖MetaQuotes标准Controls库，该库在某些MT5版本中存在已知bug和性能问题
打包文件结构复杂，源代码被合并为单一bundle文件，可读性和维护性降低
对话框UI可能占用图表空间，在较小屏幕上影响交易视图
cons_en: Purely a utility with no trading functionality, offering no direct value for users seeking trade automation only
Depends on MetaQuotes standard Controls library, which has known bugs and performance issues in certain MT5 versions
Bundled file structure is complex, with source code merged into a single file, reducing readability and maintainability
The dialog UI may occupy chart space, potentially interfering with the trading view on smaller screens
improvements: 将打包的bundle文件拆分为独立模块，提高代码可读性和可维护性
增加搜索过滤功能，允许用户快速按名称或品种筛选图表
添加键盘快捷键支持，进一步提升图表切换效率
improvements_en: Split the bundled file into independent modules to improve code readability and maintainability
Add search/filter functionality to allow users to quickly find charts by name or symbol
Add keyboard shortcut support to further enhance chart switching efficiency

risk_points: 该工具不执行任何交易操作，不存在资金风险
依赖的Controls库可能因MT5平台更新导致兼容性问题
risk_points_en: This tool does not execute any trading operations, posing no financial risk
The dependent Controls library may have compatibility issues due to MT5 platform updates

indicators_used: N/A - Utility tool, no trading indicators used
